posts.title: Comet NEOWISE Rising over the Adriatic Sea
posts.lead: This sight was worth getting out of bed early. Just over four years ago, Comet C/2020 F3 (NEOWISE) rose before dawn to the delight of northern sky enthusiasts awake that early.

posts.title: KMT-2025-BLG-0026L b
posts.lead: KMT-2025-BLG-0026L b is a gas giant exoplanet that orbits a Unknown-type star. Its mass is 2.13 Jupiters, it takes 1.4 years to complete one orbit of its star, and is 0.96 AU from its star. Its discovery was announced in 2026.
